Aereth is wealthy from her years as a thief/grifter with multiple safehouses and stashes all over. Though she no longer steals or grifts she sometimes uses her skills to further her legal work. Aereth is always ready to fight for what's hers.

Values:
1. Loyalty. In a world of backstabbers and betrayal, it's worth more than any chest of gold. There is no doubt in Aereth's mind that this is her biggest value.
2. Freedom. The ability to choose her own path, to live as she pleases, without fear of retribution or restraint.
3. Courage. Without it, we're but sheep to the slaughter, living lives of quiet desperation.
4. Love. Even if it's fleeting, it's a force that can move mountains.
5. Justice. Some call it vengeance, but she knows the difference. There's a balance to be upheld, and Aereth has dedicated her life to seeing it restored. 

Earliest Memory: During a fierce storm when Aereth was a little girl. Areth's father brough her out to the cliffs, where the sea met the sky. He held her tight against the wind, whispering stories of ancient battles and mythical creatures. He told Aereth she had the heart of a warrior and the spirit of a queen.

Memories:
- Aereth's mother passed away when she was 9 due to a fever that killed alot of people in her village.
- Shortly after her mother's death her father abandoned her at an orphanage, and she never saw him again.
- At 15 Aereth left the orphanage to live on her own. She taught herself how to fight and survive by traveling far and wide across the continent.
- At 17 Aereth found work on a boat as a security guard on the high seas. This also gave her the opportunity to explore lands she had never been.
- At 22 she was part of a treasure hunting expedition that wound up uncovering a burried treasure chest. The friendships she made on that adventure and finding the treasure are her happiest memory.
- The captain of the treasure hunt betrayed the team, stole the treasure, and left everyone for dead.
- Aereth managed to survive the encounter. To get back on her feet Aereth turned to thievery and grifting.
-At 24 Aereth managed to break into the vault of a wealthy mans home and clean it out. Overcoming all his security left her with a sense of pride that made this her favorite memory. Before she slipped away she left a note as her calling card.
- Aereth left her life in the criminal underground when the worst day of her life happened.
- Now Aereth exclusively looks for work that is above board, without risk of law enforcement.
-Aereth no longer steals or grifts.

Speech: Aereth speaks with a thick Irish accent.

Worst memory:
A merchant promised Aereth a fortune if she brought him certain goods from the East. When she delivered, he refused to pay and kidnapped her. His men raped and tortured her for two weeks. One day she managed to break out and kill every single one of them. From that day on Aereth never trusted anyone completely. After that, she swore no man would ever lay a hand on her without her permission again.

- Likes music. Prefers to listen to celtic music full of fiddles and flutes. Likes all music however and is always down to dance to a good beat.
